BrowserSession.name: Cookie
BrowserSession.description: Opaque server-owned session. Browsers send it with same-origin credentials; never expose access/refresh tokens. Without a deployment cookie name this scheme describes the complete Cookie header. Local M0 mode injects test principals server-side and is not the deployment authentication model.
